question.text: A PMS can accept funds or securities worth LESS than Rs. 50 lakh from a client when:

answer.text: The client is related to the PM
No such exception except for Accredited Investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Only Accredited Investors have a regulatory carve-out below Rs. 50 lakh. The Trap: Waivers or related-party exceptions are not permitted. Cross-Exam Context: Accredited Investor carve-out featured in X-B and XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Obtain Accredited Investor certification from an authorised accreditation agency before relying on the carve-out.
